memberdef.name: decodePayload

briefdescription.para: Decode a Kitty image payload to RGBA8.

detaileddescription.para: Decode a Kitty image payload to RGBA8 pixels.
Performs base64 decode, optional zlib decompression, then pixel extraction per the given format.

base64Data
Pointer to base64-encoded bytes.
base64Length
Number of base64 bytes.
format
Image format: 24=RGB, 32=RGBA, 100=PNG.
pixelWidth
Declared pixel width (required for f=24/32).
pixelHeight
Declared pixel height (required for f=24/32).
compressed
True if payload is zlib-compressed before base64.
Populated DecodedImage on success, or invalid on any failure.
READER THREAD only.
Steps:
Base64-decode the raw bytes via juce::Base64::convertFromBase64().
If compressed (o=z): decompress with GZIPDecompressorInputStream (zlib).
Auto-detect PNG/JPEG: if format is f=32 or f=24 AND dimensions are unknown (pixelWidth==0 or pixelHeight==0), inspect the magic bytes and override format to 100 so JUCE handles the container decode.
Dispatch on format:
f=100 (PNG/JPEG/auto): JUCE image load → ARGB convert → swizzle + un-premultiply via swizzleARGBToRGBA.
f=32 (RGBA): raw pixels, copy directly.
f=24 (RGB): raw pixels, expand to RGBA (alpha=255).
Return populated DecodedImage, or invalid on any failure.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to base64-encoded bytes.
Number of base64 bytes.
Image format: 24=RGB, 32=RGBA, 100=PNG.
Declared pixel width (required for f=24/32).
Declared pixel height (required for f=24/32).
True if payload is zlib-compressed before base64.

simplesect.para: Populated DecodedImage on success, or invalid on any failure.

briefdescription.para: Accumulate a mid-sequence chunk (m=1) into acc.

memberdef.name: finalizeChunk

briefdescription.para: Finalize a chunked sequence (m=0): append, decode, and clean up.

detaileddescription.para: Applies a metadata fallback for the single-chunk path (when acc has no metadata yet), appends any remaining payload bytes, then calls decodePayload(). On decode failure writes an error response into result. Erases the accumulator from chunks regardless of outcome.
